issues: The SCREEN HELPER HAS A BUG that likely affects other agents. helpers.js screen() calls f.resize(w, 800), which leaves the frame's primary axis FIXED at 800 px, so frames do not hug their content and anything below 800 px is clipped. My first frame came out 800 high. I fixed it by setting f.primaryAxisSizingMode = 'AUTO' right after every screen() call. The orchestrator should check other modules for frames that are exactly 800 px tall and clipped.

Auto-layout gotcha: adding a child set to FILL height inside a hug-height auto-layout turned the parent into a fixed height, which clipped the form content. I removed every spacer frame and re-hugged the forms. No frame has this problem now.

The registry has no Modal, Alert, Toast or Callout components (CMP-06/08 do not exist yet). I built these inline from tokens instead: the dialog container, alert banners (danger/warning/info/success tints with icon + label), the 3-step progress bar, the 'what happens next' step list, wallet provider rows, wallet quick-connect tiles, and caption notes with an icon.
